name: ollama-code
description: Agentic coding panel for your local Ollama models. A Claude Code / Codex–style chat experience powered by the open-source OpenCode agent, running entirely against your local models.

commands.title: Ollama Code: Open Chat in Editor Tab

ollamaCode.ollamaBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Ollama server (host root, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434).

ollamaCode.opencodePath.description: Override path to an opencode binary. Leave empty to use your own install (PATH, ~/.opencode/bin/opencode) if present, otherwise the binary bundled with this extension.

ollamaCode.serverPort.description: Port for the embedded OpenCode server. 0 = pick a free port automatically.

ollamaCode.defaultModel.description: Model id to select by default (must match an installed Ollama model, e.g. llama3.2:3b). Empty = first available.

ollamaCode.agent.description: Agent to select by default. 'build' edits your code; 'plan' is read-only. Any agent you define in .opencode/agent/*.md (or ~/.config/opencode/agent/) can also be named here — it appears in the picker after the OpenCode server restarts.

ollamaCode.autoEnsureContext.description: Before prompting, ensure the selected Ollama model is loaded with an adequate context window (num_ctx). Prevents context overflow from small default windows.

ollamaCode.minContextLength.description: Minimum context window (num_ctx) to load models with when autoEnsureContext is enabled. OpenCode's agent system prompt + tools alone use ~11k tokens, so keep this comfortably large.

ollamaCode.keepAlive.description: Default Ollama keep_alive — how long a model stays loaded after use. Use a duration like '5m', '30m', '1h', '8760h' (~forever), or '0' to unload after each use. Also settable per session from the model menu.

ollamaCode.healthCheckSeconds.description: How often (seconds) to check that Ollama is reachable and refresh model state while connected. While disconnected the extension retries every 5 seconds regardless, and the model list refreshes immediately whenever the model picker is open. Capped at 120 so the keep-warm ping always lands within the 5-minute minimum keep_alive. Takes effect within one poll cycle.

type.description: Transport. Local/stdio runs a command; remote/http/sse connects to a URL. Inferred from the fields when omitted.

command.description: Executable to run for a local server (string), with arguments in 'args'.

args.description: Arguments passed to the local server command.

env.description: Environment variables for a local server. Values may use ${VAR} references.

url.description: Endpoint URL for a remote server.

headers.description: HTTP headers for a remote server. Values may use ${VAR} references (e.g. an API token).

enabled.description: Set false to keep the server defined but not started.

enumDescriptions: Use each model's own default reasoning behavior
ollamaCode.defaultThinkingEffort.description: Starting reasoning effort for models you haven't set one for. Only models Ollama reports as thinking-capable show the control at all — sending an effort to a model without it is an error, not a no-op. Models whose template doesn't grade effort collapse low/medium/high to a single 'On'.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run check-types:test && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run check-types:test && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.package:vsix:bundled: npm run bundle:opencode && npm run bundle:provider && vsce package --target ${VSCE_TARGET:-$(node -p "process.platform+'-'+process.arch")}
scripts.test: npm run check-types:test && node esbuild.test.js && node --test "out-test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && npm run compile:integration && node out-integration/test-integration/runTests.js
